ownership_policy.DivergentUniverse: mode-owned row selected directly, by an exact Tourn3 selector or by a transitive reference from the enabled module
ownership_policy.Shared: shared stable source with an explicit reference from a selected mode row
ownership_policy.SharedCandidate: conservative frozen source obligation that is not reachable until a later exact stage/config closure proves it
ownership_policy.EvidenceOnly: excluded source retained only to prove the content boundary
ownership_policy.fail_closed: only TournRogue/Tourn3/module-6002201 selectors, transitive references or stable-ID closures grant reachability; prefixes, ID ranges and names do not

denominator_policy.current_module: Version 4.4 enables only MainTournID 3/SubTournID 1/ActivityModuleID 6002201; Tourn1/Tourn2 selected rows are historical evidence unless separately proven reused
denominator_policy.unversioned_mode_tables: mechanically relevant unversioned RogueTourn tables are conservative direct obligations, not proof that every row is active in every module
denominator_policy.room_reuse: the source has no Tourn3 room or matching layer-room rows; all Tourn2 rooms freeze as SharedCandidate obligations and P1-B1 must prove or exclude each before DataReady
denominator_policy.encounters: area entry locators, room candidates and StageConfig freeze source obligations; P2-B5 expands waves, enemy slots and bosses with exact-once parent references
denominator_policy.fixture_families: the 25 family IDs are a non-shrinking minimum; multiple fixtures may satisfy one family

profiles.membership_basis: One project profile fixed to the released Version 4.4 TournRogue boundary.

entry_points.membership_basis: Resident activity and common-title rows with the exact TournRogue selector.

enabled_modules.membership_basis: The module row transitively selected by the resident TournRogue ActivityModuleID.

finish_conditions.membership_basis: Rows whose released condition program explicitly tests RogueTourn mode 3.

area_groups.membership_basis: Area-group selector row whose TournMode is exactly Tourn3.

areas.membership_basis: Every area row whose released TournMode selector is exactly Tourn3.

difficulties.membership_basis: Difficulty rows referenced by at least one Tourn3 area.

layers.membership_basis: Layer rows referenced by at least one Tourn3 area.

layer_rooms.membership_basis: Released layer-room rows matching a Tourn3-referenced LayerID; the fixed snapshot contains none.

room_reuse_candidates.membership_basis: Conservative Tourn2 room source obligations because the snapshot has no Tourn3 room rows; each remains unproven until P1-B1 resolves stage/config reachability.

room_types.membership_basis: Distinct room types represented by the conservative room-reuse candidate set.

astronomical_divisions.membership_basis: All direct Astronomical Division level rows in the mode-owned table.

astronomical_division_effects.membership_basis: All direct Astronomical Division effect rows in the mode-owned table.

arithmetic_mapping_avatars.membership_basis: Every avatar-to-temporary-avatar mapping in the direct mode-owned table.

arithmetic_mapping_build_refs.membership_basis: Every avatar eligible for a temporary build reference.

equations.membership_basis: Every Equation row whose released TournMode selector is exactly Tourn3.

equation_displays.membership_basis: Formula display rows referenced by a Tourn3 Equation.

equation_randomizers.membership_basis: Conservative direct mode-table obligations for Equation random offer programs.

equation_keyword_params.membership_basis: All mode-owned Equation/Blessing keyword parameter rows.

blessing_paths.membership_basis: Blessing Path/type definitions selected by the Tourn3 UseBuffTypeList.

blessings.membership_basis: Distinct Blessings whose type is present in the Tourn3 active type selector.

blessing_levels.membership_basis: Every level row whose Blessing type is present in the Tourn3 active type selector.

blessing_groups.membership_basis: Every Blessing group row whose released TournMode selector is exactly Tourn3.

curio_states.membership_basis: Every Curio/Weighted Curio state row whose released TournMode is exactly Tourn3.

curios.membership_basis: Distinct handbook Curio identities transitively referenced by Tourn3 state rows.

curio_groups.membership_basis: Conservative direct mode-table obligations for Curio offer groups.

grand_miracles.membership_basis: Every Grand Miracle/Hex row whose released TournMode is exactly Tourn3.

grand_miracle_eligibility.membership_basis: Every mode-owned character Path/element eligibility row that references a Grand Miracle identity.

titan_types.membership_basis: All direct Golden Blood/Titan type rows.

titan_bless_levels.membership_basis: All direct Golden Blood's Boon level rows.

titan_talent_levels.membership_basis: All direct Titan talent level rows.

gamble_groups.membership_basis: All direct mode-owned gamble offer groups.

curse_chests.membership_basis: All direct mode-owned curse-chest service definitions.

permanent_talents.membership_basis: All direct mode-owned Inspiration Circuit talent rows.

common_constants.membership_basis: All simulation-candidate common constants; client-only constants are excluded.

weekly_modifiers.membership_basis: Conservative direct mode-table obligations for weekly/cyclical mechanical modifiers.

room_marks.membership_basis: All direct mode-owned room-mark transition records.

occurrences.membership_basis: Handbook Occurrences with at least one explicit current prefix-7 NPC-progress reference.

occurrence_variants.membership_basis: Current RogueNPC_410 rows whose stable NPC ID is referenced by a selected handbook Occurrence.

mode_service_npcs.membership_basis: Current RogueNPC_410 rows not claimed by a handbook Occurrence; P2-B4 must classify every service.

adventure_outcomes.membership_basis: All direct mode-owned abstract Adventure outcome rows.

encounter_source_obligations.membership_basis: Tourn3 area entry locators plus the conservative room-reuse set and StageConfig root; P2-B5 expands each into waves and enemy slots.

mechanic_source_files.membership_basis: Exact focused-inventory files in Divergent-specific mechanic, NPC, Occurrence, service, Adventure and maze families.

semantic_fixture_families.membership_basis: Minimum non-shrinking semantic fixture obligations; later batches may add cases.
